+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '80'
+title: 'Settings inspector look: adopt EK inspectorFieldLabels (after EK ^yey5fke)'
+---
+Blocked by EditorKit card 01M6VKYSZ0VTEP94RAGYEY5FKE (^yey5fke). Do not start until the EK API is on main and editorkit-22 sends the final names. The names below are proposals and can change.
+
+## What
+EditorKit makes the inspector look like a System Settings detail pane (EditorKit style.md, section "The inspector"):
+- A field name is the placeholder of an empty value, and is always in the tooltip and the accessibility label.
+- `.inspectorFieldLabels(.visible)` shows the names as Settings rows. In visible mode a read-only value uses the secondary text style.
+- A Bool Field in an InspectorView draws as a switch at the trailing edge, with its name at the leading edge. No style is necessary.
+- `FieldGroup.header(.hidden)` hides a group header.
+- Menu ChoiceField and ToggleField do not change.
+
+## Changes in AgentViewKit
+1. Set `.inspectorFieldLabels(.visible)` on:
+   - ConfigOptionsView `.form` (Sources/AgentViewKit/Config/ConfigOptionsView.swift, InspectorView in `content(_:)`).
+   - The session inspector (Sources/AgentViewKit/Inspection/ClientModels+Inspectable.swift, SessionModel).
+   - The tool-call inspector and the terminal inspector (Sources/AgentViewKit/Inspection/TranscriptEntries+Inspectable.swift).
+   Find where each one gets its InspectorView. If the host makes the InspectorView, document the modifier for the host and use it in the examples and the gallery.
+2. Set `FieldGroup.header(.hidden)` on the "Available" group of ToolToggles `.list` (Sources/AgentViewKit/Input/ToolToggles.swift:141).
+3. Use `FieldLabel.tooltip(help:)` for the `.help` of the menu fields: ConfigOptionsView.swift:263 and PermissionModePicker.swift:59.
+4. All other inspectors use the default (`.placeholder`).
+5. Do not change the menu styles (ConfigOptionsView `.menu`, ToolToggles `.menu`, PermissionModePicker). They keep check marks.
+6. Record new snapshot images and give the PNG paths to the user for review.
+
+## Out of scope
+The elicitation forms (ElicitationFieldChrome, Sources/AgentViewKit/Elicitation/ElicitationFieldViews.swift:107) get the Settings look in a later card. That card waits for the shared EK row view.
+
+## Acceptance criteria
+- The four inspectors show visible names. Their read-only values use the secondary text style.
+- The other inspectors show names only as placeholders and tooltips.
+- ToolToggles `.list` and ConfigOptionsView `.form` Bool rows are switches. The "Available" header is not shown.
+- The accessibility identifiers do not change. All tests pass.
+- The snapshot images are new, and the user has the paths.
\ No newline at end of file

+    Behavior notes:

+    - An empty editor reads as its placeholder in `InspectorDriver.value(of:)`. Tests that read an empty value can change.
+    - Accessibility labels and identifiers do not change.
